name: auto-hunt
author: Thomas (v4.1) / clarois (skill presets)
description: Auto-Hunt v4.1 PLUS per-player skill presets: pick a character's loadout from the dropdown and it auto-assigns those skills to hotbar slots ASDFGHJKL, then casts them on a cadence interleaved with physical attacks while hunting. Presets ship empty — build yours by copying entries from client/skill-list.json (every skill on this server, grouped by job) into client/presets.json; presets.example.json shows the shape. Physical-only behavior is unchanged: leave the dropdown on 'No skill preset'. v4.3 adds opt-in AUTO-TELEPORT: if nothing has been in range for a few seconds it presses a hotbar slot you nominate (Fly Wing item or the Teleport skill) so the character jumps to a fresh spot instead of walking an empty map. Off by default.

settings.label: Stop auto-hunting below this HP%
settings.description: A safety cutoff. If your HP ratio drops to or below this percentage, auto-hunt turns itself off rather than keep fighting unattended.

settings.label: How often to check for a target, in milliseconds
settings.description: How often Auto-Hunt checks for a target, and how often Auto-Heal checks your HP. Lower reacts faster but sends more requests; higher is gentler.

settings.label: Keyboard shortcut (physical key code) to toggle Auto-Hunt
settings.description: A browser KeyboardEvent.code name, e.g. "Comma" for ",", "KeyG" for G.

settings.label: Auto-Heal on by default
settings.description: Only sets the starting state the very first time this mod runs. After that, the button/keyboard shortcut remembers your last choice.

settings.label: Keyboard shortcut (physical key code) to toggle Auto-Heal
settings.description: Defaults to ".". Same format as the Auto-Hunt shortcut.

settings.label: Press the heal slot below this HP%
settings.description: Set higher than 'Stop auto-hunting below' so Auto-Heal gets a chance before the hard stop.

settings.label: Hotbar slot to press when healing (0-35)
settings.description: The game's hotbar is 4 rows of 9: 0-8 = F1-F9, 9-17 = 1-9 keys, 18-26 = QWERTYUIO, 27-35 = ASDFGHJKL. NOTE: v4.2 auto-assigns skill presets to the 27-35 row (ASDFGHJKL) -- put your heal slot on a different key if you run both.

settings.label: Minimum time between auto-heal presses (ms)
settings.description: Prevents mashing the heal slot faster than a potion's use-delay allows.

settings.label: Attack-skill cast cadence (ms)
settings.description: How often each assigned ATTACK skill hotbar slot is pressed while a monster has focus. The server enforces real cooldowns; this only sets how frequently the mod offers to press.

settings.label: Buff/heal refresh cadence (ms)
settings.description: How often assigned SUPPORT skills (heals/buffs recognized by name) are pressed on their long refresh cycle. If a buff in your preset has an unusual name and you want it on the long cycle instead of the attack cadence, edit client/index.js SUPPORT_NAMES.

settings.label: Auto-Teleport on by default
settings.description: Only sets the starting state the very first time this mod runs; after that the button/shortcut remembers your last choice. Ships OFF because it presses a hotbar slot -- put a Fly Wing or the Teleport skill there before turning it on.

settings.label: Keyboard shortcut (physical key code) to toggle Auto-Teleport
settings.description: Semicolon by default (the ; key). Same format as the other shortcuts.

settings.label: Hotbar slot holding Fly Wing / Teleport (0-35)
settings.description: The slot the mod presses when nothing is in range. Same layout as the heal slot: 0-8 = F1-F9, 9-17 = 1-9, 18-26 = QWERTYUIO, 27-35 = ASDFGHJKL. Keep it off the 27-35 row -- that row belongs to skill presets.

settings.label: Teleport after this long with nothing in range (ms)
settings.description: How long the hunt must find NO monster at all before jumping. Raise it if it teleports away from spawns too eagerly; lower it on crowded maps.

settings.label: Minimum time between auto-teleports (ms)
settings.description: Prevents burning wings in a row when the new spot is empty too. The server still enforces the wing's own use delay.
